name: The Reykjavík EDITION
insider_take: Iceland's first EDITION hotel brings sophisticated Nordic design to Reykjavík's vibrant harbor district, where modern luxury meets Viking heritage.
whats_special: This sleek property occupies a prime waterfront location in the Old Harbor area, offering stunning views of Mount Esja and Faxaflói Bay. The hotel showcases contemporary Icelandic design with locally-sourced materials like lava stone and driftwood, while its restaurant features New Nordic cuisine using ingredients foraged from Iceland's pristine wilderness.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room on higher floors for unobstructed vistas of the northern lights during winter months (September-March), and don't miss the hotel's curated selection of Icelandic craft spirits at the bar.
dont_miss: The hotel is steps away from Harpa Concert Hall's striking glass facade and within walking distance of the colorful Rainbow Street (Skólavörðustígur) leading to Hallgrímskirkja church. The nearby Reykjavík Maritime Museum and whale watching tours departing from the Old Harbor offer authentic Icelandic experiences right at your doorstep.
pros: Prime location in Reykjavik city center with easy access to major attractions
Contemporary luxury design with stunning views of the harbor and mountains
World-class dining and sophisticated bar scene
Exceptional service standards from EDITION Hotels luxury brand
cons: Modern minimalist style may not appeal to traditional luxury preferences
